text: SUPERVISOR — UX correction on PREFABSELECT (in your queue), user verbatim: "they always gotta do shit the complicated way dont they. the select tool for the building pieces.... just make it a key why do i have to go out of the game focus to click a button to go back into the game focus and do this whole song and dance". THE RULE: the select tool is a KEY, inside game focus — build mode already speaks keys (1-9/0 pick pieces, F1/F2 switch modes); select joins that vocabulary as a keybind toggle. NO UI-button round trip that breaks mouse capture; the user never leaves game focus to enter select mode. Pick the obvious unclaimed key, show it in the build-mode hint line like the other binds, and expose the binding as tuning the P2 way if bindings are configurable. If you already built a button path, delete it — the key IS the way in.
